precedence.primary: This file and the currentDesign fields in missions.json override 2026-10-27 3v3 easy-01..07-proposal.json and old difficulty overlays for encounter goals, maps, enemy scaling and respawn.

combat.actionModel: move plus one normal/allowed special action; initiative SPD order; three-light-enemy squad uses one shared initiative slot

terrain.wallCornerLineOfSight: adopted-2026-10-30: center-to-center straight segment; wall interiors block; exact corner blocked only with blockers on both sides; symmetric
terrain.structureLineOfSightDefault: transparent; blocks only when explicitly equipped with blocksLineOfSight=true; existing facilities gain no blocking attribute

movement.exampleMov7Build: mobile frame at core Lv21+ MOV5 + two compatible MOV+1 equipment effects (subject to restrictions); all-rounder Lv21+ MOV5 may also reach MOV7 with two effects
movement.omniRule: MOV1 around1 (8), MOV3 around2 (24), MOV5 around3 (48), MOV7 around4 (80); even MOV unlocks subset of next square ring

mov7Additions.omni: remaining 20 points of Chebyshev-distance 4 ring, completing 9x9 around origin

movement.caveat: Existing demo uses simplified BFS for some types; final MOV1..5 coordinate sets and MOV6/7 additivity must be audited on implementation without silently modifying adopted footprint.
movement.coreMovChangeAdopted: 2026-10-29: fixed core MOV3 Lv1–41; frame modifier growth Lv21 adopted for all normal and all-rounder models. Mobility frame Lv21 bonus remains unchanged.
movement.frameMovDoubleCountingGuard: frames.json/totalsAtCoreLevel.mov is the old core2-inclusive reference, NOT an additive modifier. Only frames.json/movementModifierAtCoreLevel is added to core3; do not double count.
movement.movBeyond7GeometryStatus: MOV8+ range shape remains unapproved, but no current core+frame+two MOV+1 gear reference build requires MOV8. System upper limit remains undefined.
movement.legacyFrameDataDiscrepancy: Resolved calculation: historical frames.json/totalsAtCoreLevel.mov=old core2 + frame bonus. Use explicit movementModifierAtCoreLevel and fixed core3. Group-combat effective summary normal3/4, mobility4/5, all-rounder4/5 at Lv1/Lv21.
movement.frameModifierRule: effective MOV before gear = fixed core MOV3 + corresponding frame MOV modifier. For core Lv1–20 use Lv1 modifier; Lv21–41 use Lv21 modifier. Equipment MOV modifiers are applied afterward.

traversal.maxSteps: maximum Chebyshev distance from origin to a destination in the selected movement type footprint
traversal.movementTypeUnion: union of independently legal moves; no borrowing another type path budget within a move

formations.latestRevision: 2026-10-27 adopted additive attack stats and effective DEF formulas

sharedCooldown.notes: same named technique only once per round across all directly-controlled and friendly AI initiators; supporter can still join other techniques

pincer.geometry: initiator and supporter on exact opposite vertical or horizontal sides of targeted enemy

unlocks.advancedFormations: one equipped formation-extension-unlock unlocks pincer + protective for entire allied team
unlocks.friendlyAiInitiation: one friendly-ai-formation-enabler equipped on player team enables friendly AI initiation with permission; AI initiator spends one action and own technique EN

formations.friendlyAiInitiationWhenPartEquipped: friendly-ai-formation-enabler; player may allow or deny; AI initiator spends own action and EN

combat.finalDamageRef: rules.json/combat/finalDamage (minimum1 adopted 2026-10-30; DEF floor not adopted)

tactics.name: 自由行動
tactics.focus: evaluate mission objective, useful attacks, survival and formation-support position; no fixed target

tactics.name: 集中攻撃
tactics.focus: prioritize one player-selected enemy target and seek legal line of fire; after target defeat temporarily act freely pending new designation

tactics.name: 味方護衛

tactics.name: 地点防衛

tactics.name: 地点前進
tactics.focus: travel to selected destination, use extraMove when appropriate, clear blockers and hold near destination after arrival

commonAiPriorities: prevent imminent mission failure or seize victory opportunity
favor legal future player formation setup

autoMode.on: automatic execution on own initiative turn
autoMode.off: pause before each friendly AI action and require player confirmation

allies.growth: Adopted 2026-10-29: friendly AI shares encounter enemy reference core Lv, all six fixed basic parts share the reference's enemy weapon Lv1-8; apply player core HP B and corresponding frame+parts at each level (see allies.presetGrowth). No automatic scaling to player actual Lv, no new difficulty scalar.

presetGrowth.referenceCoreLevel: Use encounter's difficulty-specific enemy reference core level (Easy/Normal/Hard per mission), not player's currently equipped core level
presetGrowth.weaponAndPartLevel: All six equipped basic parts on a friendly AI preset use the common enemy weapon level 1-8 selected by reference core level, with 2 weapon slots at same level
presetGrowth.stats: Use corresponding player frame growth (including adopted core HP B) + the same fixed preset initial equipment modifiers; do not add arbitrary friendly-AI-only stats or difficulty scalar
presetGrowth.hpGrowthRule: Share the current adopted player core HP curve and frame-only bonus from rules.json and frames.json, including the adopted 2026-10-30 rebalance; do not reuse historical certified HP snapshots.
presetGrowth.movRule: Core MOV3 + frame movement modifier (Lv21 threshold) + equipped part MOV modifiers, min MOV1; use actual movement type

certifiedCheckpoints.snapshotStatus: historical-before-adopted-2026-10-30-rebalance; numeric snapshots retained for history, not runtime values
certifiedCheckpoints.runtimeSource: Resolve current frames.json + basic-parts.json at encounter reference core/part level; see src/games/robot-tactics/friendlyPresets.ts

presetGrowth.intermediateRules: Use the player frame and basic-part interpolation adopted on 2026-10-30, including frame-only HP bonus interpolation and fixed MOV steps. No friendly-only growth curve or player-level scaling.
presetGrowth.friendBoostRule: Apply existing friendly-ai-boost addon only when equipped by player party, up to existing 15%; no innate friend stat scalar
presetGrowth.respawn: Preserve adopted ally respawn R+2, full HP and EN 30%; friendly death does not count toward 3-player same-round wipe

reinforcement.spawnTiming: start of next round after trigger
reinforcement.multipleTriggersSameRound: resolve each scheduled wave at next round start
reinforcement.spawnOccupied: use mission-specific ordered fallback cells; if none open defer; exact policy to finalize

modelRules.C: Hard only, from mission M08 onwards; never in Hard M01-M07 or in Normal
modelRules.weaponPowerSource: Use the exact existing player weapon Lv1/5/8/10 checkpoints and adopted 2026-10-29 piecewise-linear integer-round-half-up interpolation from basic-parts.json for intermediate levels

normalEarlyPolicy.role: early accessible parts/EXP growth route while Easy storyline is incomplete

lightSquads.levelSelection: derive each encounter enemy reference core level from mission's recommended level rather than apply obsolete raw difficulty multipliers
lightSquads.statTableQualification: first-pass approved baseline including model A assumptions; exact stat modifier order on swapping model B/C weapons still pending

compositionDecision.normalPolicy: same chassis, same model and same level for all three light squad members
compositionDecision.rationale: Mixed squads containing mobile plus slower types lose their MOV advantage due to mandatory 4x4 cohesion; simple homogenous squads avoid it

mixedException.note: No mixed squads are used in M01-M07 layouts; templates are accepted for later specific missions.

medium.description: common enemy, player-compatible frame and equipment, two weapons and normal special actions

statGrowth.interpolation: Piecewise linear interpolation of hp/melee/ranged/def/spd/en between checkpoints, rounding half up to integer per stat
statGrowth.movementPolicy: MOV equals Lv1 for core Lv1-20, steps up +1 at Lv21, stays through Lv41
statGrowth.equipment: Base chassis stats before weapon/gear modifiers; no model-specific stat multipliers

heavy.description: mission-specific high-performance frame; normal special actions; stronger HP/offense/DEF/EN but slower MOV/SPD possible

statGrowth.interpolation: Piecewise linear interpolation of hp/melee/ranged/def/spd/en between checkpoints, rounding half up to integer per stat
statGrowth.movementPolicy: MOV stays fixed for all core levels 1-41; apply existing weapon-specific movement modifiers separately
statGrowth.equipment: Base chassis stats before weapon/gear modifiers; no model-specific stat multipliers

boss.description: boss-target mission, individually designed unique specials and high stats; avoid inevitable hits

boss.modelCatalogException: Named bosses use separately designed loadout/unique skill; command boss M02 not assigned A/B/C

factors: current board, HP, EN, line of sight and risk
specialDecision.priority: imminent objective outcomes override routine type preference

difficultyAiQuality.hard: bounded next-player response estimation without hidden/future knowledge

soloEnemies.scaling: Use adopted seven-chassis Lv1/5/11/21/31/41 stat growth and shared enemy weapon Lv1-8 band mapping, with existing weapon-specific stat penalties and smarter AI; never stack obsolete difficulty stat scalars.

weaponLevelCommonPolicy.bossException: unique boss loadout/weapon level remains a separate pending decision, M02 command boss excluded

sharedLossConditions: all 3 distinct directly controlled robots destroyed within one same round (instant loss)
time expires before the mission win condition (except defend-to-survive objective)

spawnArea.order: sort eligible returning robots by defeat event time; for an exact tie, direct-controlled before friendly-AI; direct-controlled numbers 1->2->3, friend numbers 1->2->3

spawnArea.sameRoundMaxNormal: 2 direct controlled + 3 friendly AI = 5; pending deferred spawns may accumulate

defeatAndRespawn.carryingObjectiveWhenDefeated: drop at death location; respawn without objective item
